description: This file defines the SuiteMozaik class, which manages templates, thumbnails, and dependencies for a web-based content editing component within a SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for generating HTML components, managing thumbnails, and configuring the Mozaik editor interface.

classes.name: SuiteMozaik
classes.description: Class responsible for managing template snippets, thumbnails, and integrating the Mozaik visual editor within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SuiteMozaik object, sets up default thumbnails, and loads initial templates if necessary.

methods.name: getContentLipsum
methods.description: Provides placeholder 'Lorem ipsum' text used in thumbnail templates.

methods.name: getContentImageSample
methods.description: Generates a sample image HTML tag with optional width parameter, using current request URL to construct image source.

methods.name: getDependenciesHTML
methods.description: Outputs HTML tags to load required JavaScript and CSS resources for the editor.

methods.name: getIncludeHTML
methods.description: Outputs HTML tags for additional CSS and JS includes needed by the editor.

methods.name: tinyMCESetupArgumentFixer
methods.description: Prepares TinyMCE setup configuration, ensuring correct JSON format and syntax.

methods.name: getElementHTML
methods.description: Generates full HTML block for Mozaik editor instance, including styling, script initialization, and configuration.

methods.name: getAllHTML
methods.description: Combines all HTML parts to produce the complete editor interface for content editing.

methods.name: getRefreshTextareaScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript to synchronize editor content with textarea on user interaction.

methods.name: getThumbs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of thumbnail templates, optionally filtered by group, with caching.

methods.name: getThumbImageHTML
methods.description: Constructs HTML for thumbnail images, falling back to label if image not found.
